title: The Dancing Breeze

sources.title: Whirlwind Attack (Weapon Action)
markers: | description = Strike out at all nearby foes, making separate {{Attack roll}}s against each target.

summary: Finesse +2 glaive grants a short-rest Whirlwind Attack.

fields.Weapon profile: Martial, Two-handed, 8 ft melee (Reach), Finesse, Heavy, Dippable. 1d10 + 2 Slashing plus Strength or Dexterity. +2 to attack rolls.
fields.Whirlwind Attack: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Make separate melee weapon attack rolls against nearby enemies within 7 ft, dealing weapon damage to each hit.
fields.Rush Attack: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Action. Charge up to 30 ft and hit first non-allied creature or object for 1d4 Piercing plus attack ability modifier. STR save against weapon-action DC or Off Balance for 2 turns.
fields.Lacerate: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Action, weapon damage. CON save against weapon-action DC +2 or Bleeding for 2 turns, with 2 Slashing at turn start and Disadvantage on CON saves until healed. The condition source lists Constructs, Elementals, Plants, Oozes and most Undead as immune, with Ghasts and Ghouls as exceptions.
fields.Brace (Melee): With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Spend 20 ft of movement. Roll melee damage twice and take the higher result for this turn. Stacks with Savage Attacker for three rolls. Breaks Hiding and Invisible.
